question: Which one of the following is not an online chat software?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AWS**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **AWS (Amazon Web Services)** is a **cloud computing platform** offered by Amazon. It provides a wide range of services such as computing power, database storage, and content delivery but is **not an online chat software**.
 
• **Internet Relay Chat (IRC)** is a text-based communication tool that allows users to chat in real time. It is widely recognized as one of the earliest forms of **online chat software**. *Hence, this option is incorrect.*
 
• **Google Talk**, also known as GTalk, was a **real-time online messaging and voice-over IP service** developed by Google. It was considered an online chat software. *Hence, this option is incorrect.*
 
• **Slack** is a popular **communication platform** used primarily by teams and organizations for collaboration through channels, messages, and file sharing. It is an **online chat software**. *Hence, this option is incorrect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **AWS (Amazon Web Services):**

 
 
• AWS was launched in **2006** by Amazon and has since become one of the leading **cloud computing platforms** globally.
 
• It offers over **200 fully featured services** from data centers worldwide, including computing, storage, databases, machine learning, and AI.
 
• Notable AWS services include **Amazon EC2** (Elastic Compute Cloud), **Amazon S3** (Simple Storage Service), and **Amazon RDS** (Relational Database Service).
 
• It is widely used by businesses for hosting websites, running applications, and storing large amounts of data but does not include **real-time chat software**.
 
 
 
• **Internet Relay Chat (IRC):**
 
 
• IRC was created by **Jarkko Oikarinen** in **1988** and is one of the oldest forms of online communication.
 
• It is primarily text-based and allows users to join channels to communicate with others in real time.
 
• Although its popularity has decreased with the advent of modern messaging platforms, IRC is still used in specific communities and for technical discussions.
 
 
 
• **Google Talk:**
 
 
• Launched by Google in **2005**, Google Talk was a free communication service providing instant messaging and voice chat.
 
• It was integrated into Gmail and allowed users to communicate directly through their email accounts.
 
• In **2013**, Google announced the transition from Google Talk to its newer communication platform, **Hangouts**.
 
 
 
• **Slack:**
 
 
• Launched in **2013**, Slack is a collaborative communication tool designed for teams to exchange messages, share files, and integrate with other productivity tools.
 
• Slack supports features like **channels** for organized discussions, **direct messaging**, and **video calls**.
 
• It is widely used in professional and corporate environments, making it a popular choice for online communication and collaboration.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Difference between Cloud Platforms and Online Chat Software:**

 
 
• **Cloud Platforms** like AWS are designed to provide infrastructure, computing power, and other IT solutions, whereas **chat software** focuses on real-time communication and collaboration.
 
• Examples of cloud platforms include **Microsoft Azure**, **Google Cloud**, and **Amazon Web Services**.
 
• Examples of online chat software include **WhatsApp**, **Slack**, and **Microsoft Teams**.
 
 
 
• **Evolution of Online Chat Software:**
 
 
• Online chat software started with text-based tools like **IRC** and has evolved into modern platforms supporting **video calls**, **screen sharing**, and **file sharing**.
 
• Modern tools like **Slack** and **Microsoft Teams** cater to businesses by integrating with project management and productivity tools.
